BillingConsole.title: Billing Console
BillingConsole.subtitle: What things cost, and who owes what

PlatformCompaniesPage.title: Companies
PlatformCompaniesPage.description: Every company on this installation. Suspending one blocks its people from signing in; their customers' messages keep arriving.
PlatformCompaniesPage.confirmSuspendDescription: {{companyName}} will be blocked from signing in immediately, including anyone already signed in. Their customers' messages keep arriving, so nothing is lost.
PlatformCompaniesPage.confirmReactivateDescription: {{companyName}} will be able to sign in again straight away.
PlatformCompaniesPage.statusErrorFallback: Could not change this company's status.
PlatformCompaniesPage.readOnlyAction: This platform account has read-only access. It can view everything here, but not change it.

CompanyFeaturesDialog.title: Features for {{companyName}}
CompanyFeaturesDialog.description: Turn features on or off for this company. Anything you set here overrides their plan. Companies with no plan get everything.
CompanyFeaturesDialog.loadError: Could not load this company's features.

CompanyUsersPage.title: People at {{companyName}}
CompanyUsersPage.subtitle: Restore or remove access to this company's accounts. Platform staff never sign in as one of these people, and never see a password.
CompanyUsersPage.readOnlyNotice: You have read-only access. You can see these accounts but not change them.
CompanyUsersPage.loadError: Could not load this company's users.
CompanyUsersPage.emptyDescription: This company has not created any accounts yet.
CompanyUsersPage.ownerTooltip: Transfer ownership of this company to this person
CompanyUsersPage.lastOwnerBlocked: The last owner cannot be deactivated. Transfer ownership to somebody else first.
CompanyUsersPage.ownerRoleBlocked: The owner always holds the Owner role. Transfer ownership first.
CompanyUsersPage.noOtherRoleBlocked: This company uses only one role, so there is nothing to move them to.
CompanyUsersPage.alreadyOwnerBlocked: This person already owns this company.
CompanyUsersPage.inactiveOwnerBlocked: A deactivated account cannot take ownership. Reactivate it first.
CompanyUsersPage.deactivateBody: {{name}} will not be able to sign in again until somebody reactivates the account, and their existing sessions are revoked. A browser tab they already have open may keep working for up to 15 minutes, until its access token expires. Nothing is deleted and their history stays intact.
CompanyUsersPage.reactivateBody: {{name}} will be able to sign in again straight away, with the role they had before.
CompanyUsersPage.resetBody: A password-reset link goes to {{email}}, the address on this account and nowhere else. You will not see the new password and cannot set one.
CompanyUsersPage.verifyBody: The verification message goes to {{email}} again. This confirms the address; it is not what gates the account — signing in and acting are governed by whether the account is active and by the company's own verification.
CompanyUsersPage.roleBody: Their permissions follow the new role. The change reaches them when their session next refreshes, within about fifteen minutes.
CompanyUsersPage.roleFieldHelp: The roles this company already uses. Creating a role stays the company's own job.
CompanyUsersPage.ownerBody: {{name}} becomes the owner of this company and takes the Owner role. The current owner keeps their account but is no longer the owner.
CompanyUsersPage.reasonHelp: Required. The company reads this in their own audit log, next to your name.
CompanyUsersPage.resetSent: A password-reset link is on its way to {{email}}.
CompanyUsersPage.verificationSent: The verification email has been sent again to {{email}}.

PlatformPricingPage.title: Pricing
PlatformPricingPage.description: What companies pay per unit of usage. Company overrides beat pricing profiles, which beat the global default.
PlatformPricingPage.profileHint: Prices set here apply to every company assigned to {{name}}, unless that company has its own override.
PlatformPricingPage.uncoveredWarning: No price is configured for: {{metrics}}. Usage of these can't be billed until they have one.
PlatformPricingPage.amountHelp: Up to six decimal places — a price of 0.0005 is kept exactly, not rounded to a cent.
PlatformPricingPage.reasonHelp: Recorded in the pricing history, which is never deleted.
PlatformPricingPage.historyNote: The current price is kept. Anything already billed keeps the price it had — changing a price never re-rates past usage.
PlatformPricingPage.historyDescription: Every pricing change ever made, newest first. This record is never deleted.
PlatformPricingPage.declaredDescription: Dimensions the billing engine is designed for. Each needs its meter before a price can be set on it — a rate on an unmetered metric would charge nobody.

PlatformMailPage.title: Email delivery
PlatformMailPage.subtitle: The mail server this installation sends notifications, invites and verification emails from.
PlatformMailPage.usingEnvironment: These settings come from this server's environment configuration. Saving here overrides them; you can always reset back.
PlatformMailPage.loadFailed: Could not load the email settings.

securityHelp.starttls: Connects normally, then upgrades to an encrypted session. What most providers expect.
securityHelp.tls: Encrypted from the first byte. Usually port 465.
securityHelp.none: Unencrypted. Only safe for a mail server on this machine or a trusted private network.

PlatformMailPage.passwordUnchanged: Leave blank to keep the saved password.
PlatformMailPage.passwordWillChange: This will replace the saved password.
PlatformMailPage.saveFailed: Could not save the email settings.
PlatformMailPage.testSubtitle: Sends a real email using the settings currently in force, so you find out now rather than when a customer doesn't receive something.
PlatformMailPage.testDelivered: Test message sent. Check that inbox to confirm it arrived.

PlatformCompanyBillingPage.title: Billing
PlatformCompanyBillingPage.subtitle: What this company is charged, and why. All figures come from the pricing engine — billed in {{currency}}.
PlatformCompanyBillingPage.loadFailed: Could not load this company's pricing.
PlatformCompanyBillingPage.readOnlyNotice: Your account has read-only access. You can see everything here, including the full history, but not change it.
PlatformCompanyBillingPage.profileSubtitle: A profile sets prices for a group of companies. A company override always wins over it.
PlatformCompanyBillingPage.reasonHelp: Recorded in the history. "Why is this customer on Enterprise?" is the question asked six months later.
PlatformCompanyBillingPage.effectiveSubtitle: Resolved by the pricing engine at {{when}}.
PlatformCompanyBillingPage.overrideReplacing: This company already has its own price for this. Saving replaces it from now on; the old one stays in the history.
PlatformCompanyBillingPage.overrideCreating: Currently using the {{source}}. A company price overrides it from now on.
PlatformCompanyBillingPage.overrideAmountHelp: Up to six decimal places. Sub-cent prices are normal.
PlatformCompanyBillingPage.overrideReasonHelp: Required. Recorded against the change with your name and the date.
PlatformCompanyBillingPage.overrideFailed: Could not save the price. It may have been changed by someone else — reload and try again.
PlatformCompanyBillingPage.previewSubtitle: Asks the pricing engine what it would charge, for any moment in time. This is the same answer a closing month will use.
PlatformCompanyBillingPage.previewNoPrice: No price is set for that at that moment, so nothing would be charged. Usage would be recorded as unpriced.
PlatformCompanyBillingPage.historySubtitle: Every pricing change for this company: what changed, who changed it, when it took effect, and why. Nothing here is ever deleted.
PlatformCompanyBillingPage.historyEmpty: No pricing changes have been made for this company.
PlatformCompanyBillingPage.previewFailed: The pricing engine could not be reached. Try again shortly.

PricingEditor.title: Pricing for {{metric}}
PricingEditor.subtitle: Per {{unit}}, in {{currency}}. Saving writes a new rate — the current one is closed, never overwritten.
PricingEditor.tierHint: The last step has no upper bound, so every volume has a price.
PricingEditor.includedHint: Units that cost nothing each period. Leave blank for the metric's default; 0 means none.
PricingEditor.minimumHint: A floor under the period's total for this metric.
PricingEditor.previewEmpty: Enter a rate to see what it charges.
PricingEditor.reasonHint: Recorded in the pricing history. Somebody will ask about this change in six months.
PricingEditor.historyNote: Anything already billed keeps the price it had — changing a price never re-rates past usage.
PricingEditor.saveError: That price could not be saved.

flat.name: Flat rate
flat.description: One rate for every unit, however much is used.

volume_tier.name: Volume tiers
volume_tier.description: The period's total picks one rate, and every chargeable unit is charged at it. A busier period makes every unit cheaper.

graduated_tier.name: Graduated tiers
graduated_tier.description: Each bracket keeps its own rate and the units are split across them — the first N at one price, the next M at another.

package.name: Packages
package.description: Sold in blocks: a fixed amount buys a fixed quantity, part-blocks rounded up.

fixed_fee.name: Fixed fee
fixed_fee.description: A flat amount per period regardless of usage — a seat or a plan fee.

committed.name: Committed usage
committed.description: A quantity paid for whether or not it is used, with a separate rate beyond it.

subscription.name: Subscription plan
subscription.description: A plan fee with entitlements across several metrics.
